official_policy_source.title: 2026 Gangnam SME loan interest support program
official_policy_source.body_text: 2026 Gangnam SME loan interest support program. Applications are accepted from 2026-08-01 to 2026-12-31. Support limit: KRW 50,000,000. Interest rate discount: 2 percentage points. Eligible businesses: Gangnam small businesses.
